pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular sub-polygonal dark regions with variable edge definitions. Anterior patches on the neck and chest are smaller and more densely packed, while lateral flank patches are larger with more complex, non-linear boundaries and soft internal pixel gradients.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Negative space network of cream-colored interstitial pathways forming tri-radial junction nodes. Corridor width remains relatively constant across the mid-flank with high topological continuity and clear pixel-level separation between adjacent patches.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible short-haired mane along the dorsal neck boundary with a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette profile against the sky.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Localized clusters of hyper-pigmented, texturally disrupted spots observed within several primary brown patches on the mid-to-upper flank.
